Free · 50 cards

This or that: what would your partner choose?

Beach holiday or city trip? Karaoke night or board game night? For every card, say what your partner would pick, then they reveal. Who guesses right more often?

What Would Your Partner Choose?1 / 50

Beach holiday or city trip?

Say what the other would pick. Then they reveal.

Tip: arrow keys and swiping work too.

How to play

  1. One of you reads the card and guesses what the other would choose.
  2. The other reveals, and explains if it was close.
  3. One point per correct guess. Swap after ten cards.
  4. A tie? The next card decides.
